command:
cd /workspace && cat <<'EOF' > plus_comm.v
Require Import Arith.

Theorem plus_comm : forall n m : nat,
  n + m = m + n.
Proof.
  intros n m.
  induction n as [|n' IHn'].
  - simpl.
    symmetry.
    apply Nat.add_0_r.
  - simpl.
    rewrite IHn'.
    rewrite Nat.add_succ_r.
    reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF
printf '%s\n' '--- source ---'
nl -ba plus_comm.v
printf '%s\n' '--- compile ---'
rm -f plus_comm.vo
coqc plus_comm.v
status=$?
printf 'coqc status: %s\n' "$status"
ls -l plus_comm.v plus_comm.vo 2>&1
exit "$status"
